test_arms.purpose: Verify package bytes, schemas, provenance, frozen identities, and unresolved blockers before any execution.
Discriminate the declared restricted Solar Schwarzschild 1PN acceleration from preregistered equation mutants.
Recover the analytic perihelion coefficient across the frozen eccentricity, inverse-c-squared, step, and event-tolerance Cartesian matrix.
Compare total state and isolated 1PN differential signal against a separately coded arbitrary-precision high-order oracle with self-convergence.
Recover the declared static-Sun massless-target 1PN equation from an independent harmonic-gauge EIH evaluator at fixed total mu over the frozen nu ladder.
Demonstrate frozen common-endpoint second-order step convergence and solver-tolerance independence.
Separate step error from Decimal precision error on the complete frozen h-by-precision Cartesian grid.
Verify exact coherent-unit changes and the retained L_B-derived TCB-to-TDB compatible affine scaling, including accelerations and tolerances.
Enforce sealed expectations, complete scientific-case custody, and the first-valid-unblinding-only policy.
Require all component and total error-budget gates and enforce the exact nonauthorizing claim ceiling.

gates.metric: All package, schema, provenance, identity, and blocker checks are satisfied.
All preregistered equation mutants are rejected and exact analytic identities pass.
Every frozen paired perihelion case cell meets its coefficient error budget.
Every frozen total-state and differential-signal oracle cell meets its budget after oracle self-convergence.
The fixed-total-mu nu ladder recovers the declared restricted 1PN equation within budget.
The frozen common-endpoint step and solver-tightening diagnostics satisfy the declared acceptance rule.
The complete h-by-precision grid demonstrates the declared Decimal precision plateau.
Both exact-unit and TCB-to-TDB compatible transform pairs satisfy state, acceleration, and tolerance covariance.
Custody, sealed expectations, and the first valid unblinding record cover every required scientific case role.
All nine-component and total error-budget gates pass and only the exact permitted nonauthorizing claim is emitted.

allowed_verdicts.BLOCKED: A prerequisite, source, value, budget, or independent arm is missing.
allowed_verdicts.INVALID: A hash, schema, execution, retention, or unblinding rule was violated.
allowed_verdicts.FAIL: At least one conjunctive scientific gate failed.
allowed_verdicts.CONFLICT: Individually valid arms disagree outside their frozen budgets.
allowed_verdicts.ELIGIBLE_FOR_REVIEW_NONAUTHORIZING: Q0 through Q9 all passed and the complete package may be submitted for external scientific review.

verdict_policy.permitted_claim_text: For the frozen cases and declared domain in qualification package <qualification_id>, the nonauthorizing JX reference path reproduced the declared restricted static-Sun, massless-target Schwarzschild 1PN equation within the preregistered numerical and model-matched error budgets. The resulting trajectories are MODEL_OUTPUT and are eligible only for external scientific review.

limitations: Restricted static spherical Sun and massless-target Solar Schwarzschild 1PN only.
No full EIH N-body implementation or observational ephemeris qualification.
No holdout trajectories, outcomes, performance claims, or registry authorization are present.
nonclaim: This pre-execution package is MODEL_OUTPUT only and grants no registry or scientific-propagation authority.
